  forall (n : nat) (a : nat -> R),
    (forall i, (i < n)%nat -> 0 <= a i) ->
    sum_n a n = INR n ->
    prod_n a n <= 1.

Induct on the stronger bound for all m >= 2. In the successor case, obtain the predecessor bound through an explicit assertion and `apply IH; lia`, unfold or `change` the recursive product into its multiplication form, prove the reciprocal relation for the next power using `cbn [pow]; field; nra`, rewrite it, and finish with `nra` using the supplied positivity facts. Finally destruct n into 0, 1, and at least 2; discharge the first two cases directly and use the stronger bound plus positivity of the reciprocal in the final case.
